_comment: DECORATIVE-ONLY text seasoning placements for zelda3. `msg` is the game message index (0-based, same numbers the engine uses; dialogue.txt line number is msg+1). `expected_original` is the exact current dialogue.txt line content (after 'N: ') — the tool refuses to apply if the live text drifted from this. `new_text` must be plain text (no [commands]) using only the US text alphabet. Every entry here was hand-classified as DECORATIVE (sign text or flavor NPC one-liner with zero hint/quest/load-bearing content). See TEXT_SEASONING.md.

placements.where: Kakariko NW overworld sign (area 0x18, same screen as the cucco pen; previously the WANTED poster sign)
placements.why_decorative: Overworld sign text via kOverworld_SignText / player.c:3796. Signs are flavor by definition; content is not referenced by any game logic.
placements.expected_original: [LinkL][LinkR]  WANTED!  This is the[2]criminal who kidnapped Zelda.[3]Call a soldier if you see him!

placements.where: Zora Falls Outskirts overworld sign (area 0x0F, previously 'DANGER! Beware of deep water and Zora!')
placements.why_decorative: Overworld sign text via kOverworld_SignText / player.c:3796. Pure flavor sign.
placements.expected_original: DANGER![2]Beware of deep water and Zora!

placements.where: Tutorial soldier NPC one-liner (sprite_main.c Sprite_TutorialGuardOrBarrier cycle, msg 0x0F..0x15; previously 'Us soldiers have been around, kid...')
placements.why_decorative: Content-free filler one-liner; unlike its six siblings in the tutorial cycle (msgs 0x10..0x14, 0x0F) it contains no control hints or quest info. Those siblings are NOT touched.
placements.expected_original: Us soldiers have been around,[2]kid.  You can learn a lot from[3]us.  But you already know that!

placements.where: Kakariko sweeping lady NPC (sprite_main.c Sprite_SweepingLady msg 0xA5; previously 'Oh, [Name]. The rumors say you kidnapped the Princess...')
placements.why_decorative: Pure flavor NPC one-liner; no item, no hint, no quest state. Sole reference: sprite_main.c:12723.
placements.expected_original: Oh, [Name].  The rumors say[2]you kidnapped the Princess,[3]but I still trust you.

placements.where: Locksmith NPC idle line (sprite_main.c Sprite_39_Locksmith case 0 'chilling', msg 0x107; previously just '[...] [...] [...]')
placements.why_decorative: The NPC's idle string is literally only dots. Chest-adjacent NPC. His quest lines (0x108-0x10C) are NOT touched.

placements.where: QuarrelBros older brother, door-open state (sprite_main.c Sprite_QuarrelBros msg 0x130)
placements.why_decorative: Flavor chatter between the two quarreling brothers; no item or flag depends on it.
placements.expected_original: So the doorway is open again[...][2]OK OK, maybe I should make up[3]with my brother[...]

placements.why_decorative: Flavor chatter between the two quarreling brothers ('Look At Us' lands on the pair).
placements.expected_original: Hey [Name], did you come from[2]my older brother's room?  Is he[3]still angry?

placements.where: Flute boy's father in Kakariko, AFTER the flute quest is fully done (sprite_main.c Sprite_FluteDad, msg 0xA4; previously 'Zzzzzzz... Snore')
placements.why_decorative: Post-quest snore line, only reachable when link_item_flute >= 2. His quest lines (0xA1-0xA3) are NOT touched.

skipped.reason: No decorative game-over slot exists: the game-over screen text is the save/quit choice menu (msgs 0-4), which is load-bearing UI. Skipped per guardrail.
